audience: Readers seeking clear, source-backed explanations of XRP, the XRP Ledger, Ripple, related products, regulation, and market developments

voice.tone: Sharp, informed, evidence-driven, practical, and free of hype
voice.notes: Lead with the answer. Explain technical and financial terms in plain language. Separate confirmed facts, interpretation, uncertainty, and what to watch. Present material bull and bear implications when relevant. Never use em dashes.

source.evidencePolicy: Material claims need dated, linked evidence. Prefer an official primary record plus independent support. Attribute vendor claims and distinguish proposals, development branches, releases, and live Mainnet behavior.

assetPolicy.brandLogos: Use verified official logos. Never generate or recreate a logo with AI.
assetPolicy.screenshots: Use genuine interfaces or clearly labeled official website captures when the article needs them.
assetPolicy.articleMedia: Follow docs/EDITORIAL_IMAGE_SYSTEM.md and the aaxrp-classical-ascii-v2 system. Preserve provenance and publication rights for third-party media.

cms.outputFormat: content/news JSON rendered by the existing article route

publishingApproval.notes: This profile records the review owner but grants no publication authorization.

conversionGoal: Help readers understand the evidence and continue to the most relevant AllAboutXRP guide, news analysis, data page, or newsletter offer
geography: Global, with jurisdiction-specific claims labeled explicitly
units: Use source-native units and add reader-friendly conversions when material
currency: USD unless the source or topic requires another currency

domainReview.notes: Financial, legal, regulatory, protocol, and security claims require source-level review appropriate to the topic. Do not imply legal, tax, or investment advice.
